user_intent_source.intent: shared local perception supports obvious anomalies and task-directed fine refinement of normal or damaged regions

candidate.name: multiscale_surface_statistics_shared_MLP
candidate.geometry: one current full mesh area normal computation and KDtree per observation, one batched maximal1024-neighbor query for384 F points, all scales reuse prefixes
candidate.ring: distance>=0.6 current kth radius, six-term local tangent quadratic ridge1e-6, current area weights; signed residual query minus fitted center height
candidate.network: shared Linear16,32 GELU Linear32,32 GELU on point-scale rows, concatenate five32D features, Linear160,64 GELU Linear64,1
candidate.context_rationale: F384, maximal1024 neighbors includes at least640 points outside any true changed support confined toF. Label-based posthoc coverage only. Euclidean near-neighbors may cross nearby sheets, retained diagnostic limitation.
candidate.choice_basis: reuse existing current reader, topology and exact measurements, learn shared local multiscale patterns with full batch tensor operations; no checkpoint download or repeated per-query deep encoder

data.normalization: development hierarchical case weights only, merge five scales in same16 channels, two-pass moments, divisor1 ifstd<1e-6
data.labels: synthetic actual displacement support, normals include natural concavity negatives

training.index: exact DATA001 saved1200x1024 paired-state indices, same rows both versions
training.initial_loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss, pos_weight=(1-pi)/pi from new dev hierarchy
training.optimization: after v1 dev-only paired logit diagnostics and committed binding, same initialization and indices, add0.1 positive-pair hinge relu(1-(z_d-z_n)), no validation-tuned choice
training.calibration: each version16dev normal F max score, q95 methodhigher, strictlygreater threshold. With16 values this is max, disclose finite dependent normal controls, no probability calibration

evaluation.baseline: untrained multiscale outer-ring quadratic residual magnitude max across five scales, same current input/area budget; uses existing MLS residual principle, no label-selected scale
evaluation.scale_groups: posthoc original r/R_current bins<=.5,(.5,1],>1 and independent whole-center-neighborhood diagnostic, denominators unchanged

interfaces.inspect: current scope ->25%area attention candidates plus separately thresholded unconfirmed synthetic-depression prediction
interfaces.focus: explicit target and protected sourceIDs ->direct current geometry facts and appendable topological context, model_invoked=false, no score gate
interfaces.reference: current vertices/topology/F mapping/sourceIDs/kind/provenance hashed, persisted; stale bindings rejected
interfaces.semantics: explicit source-point binding, anatomical or artistic part classifier absent

consumer.fairness: same task bytes/aliases/prompt goal and output schema, same model/effort/tool-call budget, fresh ephemeral session per task route. Native gets full current geometry and reasonable numpy/scipy Python. facts adds direct facts/reference tools, learned adds optimized inspect scores. Focus direct path cost/results kept separate.
consumer.execution: local CLI ChatGPT login, no other provider; preserve real launch/provider failures then complete local work; no retries of completed task prompts
consumer.scoring: parse final JSON, area-weighted centroid/area/bbox/normals/source-ID mapping from current geometry, inspect selected area<=25% and actual support recall, anomaly assertions separate from candidate attention, author plan scoring explicit, retain all raw outputs for independent blind review

answer_schema.selected_source_ids: integer list, chosen region for inspect, exact explicit target for focus

consumer.cost: record first imports/current reads, feature preparation/cache/predict delivery and references plus actual CLI wall/tool calls/tokens where exposed. Tokens and fees unavailable become unknown, not0; images0 unless actual image requested and generated

adoption: all fixed gates and full consumer costs reported. One optimization then adopt/reject conclusion, no further seed/model/source search
completion: one fixed commit callback then end awaiting independent review
